- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Early partnerships with ISVs and SIs can increase market reach for a new platform.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Partnerships can provide access to expertise and resources, such as technical support and software development.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Co-development opportunities can arise from partnerships with ISVs and SIs, leading to customized solutions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Early partnerships can help a new platform gain traction and establish credibility.
- [USER] User requested convincing arguments for prioritizing ISV relationships.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] ISVs have an established customer base that a new platform can leverage.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Partnering with multiple ISVs can expand a platform's reach to various industries and geographies.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] ISVs can help reduce the time to market for a new platform.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Partnerships with ISVs provide access to additional resources and expertise, including software development and marketing.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] ISVs can drive innovation by contributing new ideas and solutions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Prioritizing ISV relationships can lead to increased adoption rates and a stronger competitive advantage.
- [USER] User asked how extensibility fits into the ISV partnership model, especially for the metaverse industry.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Extensibility allows a platform to integrate with third-party solutions and be extended by developers and partners.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Extensibility is essential in the metaverse industry for flexibility and customization.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Prioritizing extensibility can attract more developers and partners to the platform.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Working closely with ISVs can help build necessary integrations and provide tools for development.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A collaborative partnership with ISVs can enhance user experience.
